sec-alert-bot: 🚨 Automated build inspector flagged a suspicious PyPI package during image creation: package 'rwnlib' (typo of 'redwoodlib') had a postinstall script that writes to /usr/local/bin. We quarantined the affected images from today's CI runs (builds 4521-4525). Immediate actions recommended below.

anna (security): TL;DR: treat as a supply-chain typosquat. No customer data exfil detected so far, but we need to assume compromise of build artifacts. Steps: 1) pause auto-deploys for images built between 2026-03-23 02:10-02:45 UTC, 2) rotate CI deploy keys, 3) rebuild from clean caches, 4) run a quick indicator search in repos & infra. I'll coordinate.

mike (build): On it. Paused the release pipeline for the affected tag. Which GH actions secrets to rotate?

anna (security): rotate the `CI_DEPLOY_KEY` and any repo-scoped `ACTIONS_TOKEN` used in the runners. Also rotate the service account key used by the image-builder VM (jen, tagging you). Commands:

```
# revoke GH deploy key (example)
gh api --method DELETE /repos/redwood/infra/deploy-keys/12345 --header "Authorization: token $GH_ADMIN_TOKEN"
# revoke repo secret
gh secret delete CI_DEPLOY_KEY --repo redwood/infra
# revoke GCP service account key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=builder@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

zoe (eng-oncall): Do we need an org-wide rotation or just the few CI keys? Any indicators of lateral movement from the builder VM?

anna (security): Start with the CI and builder VM keys; if we find evidence in logs that the package executed commands with other credentials, escalate to org-wide. Search for suspicious command executions in build logs: look for `curl`, `nc`, `bash -c` and unexpected chmod/chown on /usr/local/bin.

jen (infra): I'm running the grep across recent build logs now. Quick check: `zgrep -E "curl |nc |bash -c|chmod [0-7]{3}" /var/log/ci-builds/*.gz | head`

mike (build): I've kicked off a clean rebuild of base images (no caches) on a quarantined runner pool. Tagging new images `base:20260323-clean-1`. Will push after verification.

devops-bot: CI pipeline release/redwood-api tagged `halted-by-security-1876543210` and workflows disabled for affected repo: infra, platform, inference-service.

anna (security): Action owners: mike -> rebuild images and verify binaries; jen -> rotate builder VM keys and confirm no new keys issued; zoe -> run artifact and log searches for indicators; myself -> craft customer/internal comms if there's any exposure. Post status updates here. If you find suspicious commits or artifacts, paste hash + small snippet (no secrets). :lock: :mag:
